notes: The projection carries τῷ κυρίῳ; the ASV's marginal note about the opportunity reading is not acted on inside the alignment (rule 12).

τῇ and τῷ stand before determinerless English datives and are unrepresented under rule 21's determinerless clause, while τῷ κυρίῳ has a written the and takes it under rule 19; δουλεύω governs the dative directly and the ASV writes no preposition.
